audit.method: read-only multi-agent evidence sweep + adversarial verification pass

M1_abstraction.justification: One real gateway (Gemini, aiGateway.ts) + clean escalation choke point (mapModel), but 10 raw provider call sites, 4 drifting config copies, non-uniform streaming, 361-line dead router (providerRouting.ts, zero importers).

M2_retrieval.justification: Solid memory recall (sqlite-vec+FTS5 hybrid, 3 consistent ports, unit-tested); zero reranker anywhere; web retrieval is wholesale Perplexity delegation with no owned pipeline.

M3_memory_personality.justification: Memory core live and composed-at-runtime (3/5) but 'deletable' is false, hygiene loops severed, upsert duplicates facts; personality is a hardcoded prose constant (1/5) with one clean injection seam.

M4_atlas1.justification: No local inference, no LLM weights, no SFT logging (messages table has zero writers), no success signal, no consent — the dataset is not accumulating.

M5_admin_selfdev.justification: Minimal capability manifest + fixed no-code-exec tool set; signing, updater, sandbox, enforced approval, rollback, kill switch all missing; CI doesn't trigger on the working branch.

M6_global_brain.justification: Nothing cross-user exists — no sharing, distillation, opt-in, or poisoning defense. Zero current legal exposure from it; the live legal surface is elsewhere.
